title: VII–XII. Actual sin: definition, kinds against the law of works, and omissions
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): I do not punish, I do not rebuke, I do not withstand, but I command plus defend anothers sins — i do not uncover ye fault. I counsel, I command, I consent, I provoke, I praise; that same which ye ancients expressed in these verses: — communication with others sins stands as also sin. Sin belonging toward omission stands as ye neglect belonging toward a due office. Sin against ye law belonging toward works stands as ye transgression belonging toward ye moral precepts belonging toward ye Decalogue plus belonging toward ye law belonging toward nature. XII. into sins against God, neighbor, plus oneself. into sins belonging toward heart, mouth, plus work; It stands as distinguished into sins belonging toward commission plus belonging toward omission; whether inward or outward, dissonant out from Gods law — aCTUAL sin stands as called by means belonging toward ye Scholastics plus theologians every act. VII.
pass_b_english: VII. ACTUAL sin is called by the Scholastics and theologians every act, whether inward or outward, dissonant from Gods law. It is distinguished into sins of commission and of omission; into sins of heart, mouth, and work; into sins against God, neighbor, and oneself.

XII. Sin against the law of works is the transgression of the moral precepts of the Decalogue and of the law of nature. Sin of omission is the neglect of a due office. Communication with others sins is also sin, which the ancients expressed in these verses: I counsel, I command, I consent, I provoke, I praise; I do not uncover the fault, I do not punish, I do not rebuke, I do not withstand, but I command and defend anothers sins.
source_text: VII. ACTUALE peccatum a Scholasticis et Theologis dicitur omnis actus, sive interior sive exterior, dissonans a lege Dei. Distinguitur in peccata commissionis et omissionis; in peccata cordis, oris, et operis; in peccata contra Deum, proximum, et seipsum. XII. Peccatum contra legem operum est transgressio praeceptorum moralium Decalogi et legis naturae. Peccatum omissionis est neglectus debiti officii. Communicatio cum peccatis alienis etiam peccatum est, quod veteres his versiculis expresserunt: Consulo, praecipio, consentio, provoco, laudo, non retego culpam, non punio, non reprehendo, non obsto, sed praecipio et defendo aliena.
